# Workplace from Meta

> > Workplace from Meta is an all-in-one business communication platform combining chat, video, groups, and collaboration tools for enterprise organizations.

Workplace from Meta provides comprehensive documentation and resources for business teams using the platform for internal communication and collaboration. The site covers product features, migration guidance, and support for organizations transitioning from legacy systems.
